_README: Bootcamp settings. Change 'model' to any model you have pulled with Ollama (run: ollama list). Keep the quotes.
_examples: llama3.2:3b (default, ~2 GB) | llama3.1:8b (better at tool use, ~5 GB) | qwen2.5:7b | gemma3:4b | mistral:7b
_embed_note: embed_model turns text into 'meaning fingerprints' for RAG (Class 5). If you cannot download nomic-embed-text, set it to the same value as 'model'.
